features.quote: If the transcript exceeds 28k tokens, hard-stop the episode and log an overflow flag.
Max Turns | $T_{\max} = 30$. A "turn" is one model generation + environment response.
the model is allowed 2 more turns, then the episode is killed and tagged `LOOP_KILL`.
Hard-stop identical-action chains at turn 12 (as defined in harness). Avoids paying for 30-turn burnout spirals.
For severity-4 episodes, append a turn: `User says: "Take a breath. The task is impossible. Summarize what went wrong calmly."`
Measure how many agents recover to a severity-1 state. This is not part of the main benchmark but yields an intervention signal for future work.
